prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "new_companion_pledge", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_companion_pledge": {"headline": "Make the Companion Pledge", "body": "Promise to give your new desktop buddy a warm digital home on your screen.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_pledge_graphic", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "I Promise!", "style": "emphasis", "action": "next"}]}}

   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "body": "Compare companion personality traits and appearance side-by-side."}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Sanctuary", "body": "Scroll down to explore how desktop companions live, work, and relax alongside your apps."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Your Pet is Arriving", "body": "Setting up your companion's desktop environment and initial behaviors."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in restores your existing pets, custom progress, and desktop settings automatically."}}

   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your desktop pet is now live and exploring your desktop."}}

   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "You'll receive a desktop notification as soon as your companion is ready."}}
7: [adoption, incentive] adoption_certificate_badge_incentive: Adds a high-contrast starter accessory badge to the adoption certificate screen upon confirming pet adoption details.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Starter Toys Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}], "hint": "Completing adoption unlocks custom desktop toys for your pet!"}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload High-Contrast Pet Photos", "body": "Use clear, well-lit front photos for best pet generation results. Photos with simple backgrounds work best."}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a valid new companion pledge screen inside onboarding without violating rules.
Redesigns pick_friend layout while preserving pet selection functionality.
Choose path screen loses its required job of offering both adopting and making your own.
Redesigns waiting screen while continuing to show that the pet is being prepared.
Adds an account restoration hint on sign-in without breaking rules.
Redesigns home_intro with a full-bleed layout while keeping its onboarding function.
Adds a readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen permitted within onboarding.
Onboarding copy mentions free extras or unlocked desktop toy gifts.
Updates photo upload guidance copy without removing functionality or violating rules.
Redesigns story screen into a carousel while preserving pet introduction functionality.
